Constraint-level coverage

Every inventoried component has two-sided evaluation evidence. 1991 component obligations; 1991 have observed success and failure; 0 were never evaluated in these 2163 retained validation calls.

Integrated pySHACL component evaluations in current shared corpora, vocabulary fixtures and procedural geospatial/video/numeric gates. Each case is validated in the context of the modules its own terms belong to, so an evaluation recorded for a case is one the case's data caused. Nested branch failures may occur within conforming graphs; two-sided evaluation is not independent semantic review or proof that each parameter is necessary. Empty-value passes are recorded separately and count as positive evidence only for cardinality components, where zero is a meaningful input. Rules and custom targets are not constraint components.
